**Jargon Explainer:** *This motion stops the debate and forces an immediate vote on whatever is being discussed. It decides only that the talking ends. It does not decide the underlying question, which is put to a separate vote straight afterwards. It cannot be moved for proceedings already covered by a time limit (a 'guillotine'), because the timetable has taken its place.*

At 10:15 AM, a majority voted for a procedural motion introduced by Representative [Jordan McAllister](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/representatives/brightwater/jordan_mcallister) (Labor) to end the debate on [Border Processing Amendment Bill 2026](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/bills/border-processing-amendment-bill-2026) and put the question immediately, which means it was successful. The House of Representatives then voted on the question itself.

Nobody voted against their party on this occasion.

### Motion Text

> That the question be now put.
